## Required before build (macOS host — stop condition)
1. Open `ios/App/App.xcworkspace` in **Xcode 16+** (Swift Package Manager resolves Capacitor).
2. Set Bundle Identifier to `com.iamanartist.app` (matches `capacitor.config.ts` appId).
3. Team + Signing: assign an Apple Developer team (personal/team provisioning). **Stop condition: Apple Developer account.**
4. Add `GoogleService-Info.plist` to `ios/App/App/` and add to target membership (see FIREBASE_NATIVE_SETUP.md).
5. (If using native splash/theme beyond asset catalog) confirm `LaunchScreen.storyboard` image set name "Splash" resolves — already wired.

open ios/App/App.xcworkspace

## Deployment target notes
- Capacitor 8 / `@capacitor/ios@8.1.1` requires **iOS 13+**. Bump if app needs lower.
- Uses Swift PM (Package.swift) — no CocoaPods required.
